$comment: web-excellence pack hooks. install.sh merges this into .claude/settings.json; if you are wiring it by hand, merge the three arrays into your existing hooks block rather than replacing it. `timeout` is in SECONDS per the Claude Code hook schema — a repo whose other hooks carry timeout:5000 is using a different tool's convention, do not copy it. The stop hook gets longer because it reads the transcript and runs one `git status`. Commands go through ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}, the placeholder the Claude Code hooks reference documents, because hooks run in the session's current directory, which moves when the agent `cd`s. Claude Code substitutes it itself, so it also works where a shell would not expand a POSIX `${VAR:-default}`.
